    python -B verify.py --work ../fresh-wavefront-run

The output directory must be new and outside this package. The verifier validates the LF-aware manifest, normalizes a scratch copy, reconstructs the complex word from primitive inputs through the complete static44/frame/syndrome/wave/coset chain, runs the actual local phase and all-column checks, rebuilds the complete physical owner controller, recounts the invoice, and certifies both moment endpoints plus the outer assembly.
